manifest_scope.statement: Values are transcribed from identified public files. This manifest does not decide which object scope or matrix combination forms the research plant.

platform_mass_and_inertia.transformation: identity; source values are already dimensional SI quantities

hydrostatic_hull_stiffness_about_prp.transformation: OpenFAST redimensionalization with rho=1025 kg/m^3, g=9.81 m/s^2 and WAMITULEN=1 m; stored values are rounded dimensional transcriptions

infinite_frequency_added_mass_about_prp.transformation: OpenFAST redimensionalization with rho=1025 kg/m^3 and WAMITULEN=1 m; reciprocal terms may collapse to one rounded value

whole_system_mass_and_local_mooring_stif.transformation: identity; auxiliary WAMIT force-control input already stores dimensional SI values

mooring_geometry.transformation: identity; source values are already dimensional SI quantities

report_only_geometry.source_note: Displaced geometry and reference ballast inventory are taken from NREL/TP-5000-76773; they are not interpreted as active-tank geometry.

report_static_vertical_balance.source_note: NREL/TP-5000-76773 reports the assembled mass, displaced volume and total mooring vertical pretension at the installed 20 m draft. These rounded report values are retained only as equilibrium evidence and do not replace the executable OpenFAST mass matrix.

report_hydrostatic_mass_separation.source_page: PDF page 14, report Section 2.1 immediately before Table 3
report_hydrostatic_mass_separation.source_note: The report states that the WAMIT roll and pitch entries contain the water-plane and center-of-buoyancy contribution, while the mass contribution is calculated separately by OpenFAST.

hydrodynamic_added_mass.object_scope: potential-flow body about the WAMIT/OpenFAST reference point

representation_groups.selection_rule: Platform-only and whole-system rigid-body representations are mutually exclusive candidates until a runtime assembly recipe defines object scope, reference point transformation and included fixed ballast. Added mass may only be combined after that recipe is confirmed.

version_differences: NREL/TP-5000-76773 reports platform center of mass z=-14.94 m, while the v1.1.16 ElastoDyn file uses z=-14.4 m.
The report contains platform-mass values of 17839 t and 17854 t in different locations, while v1.1.16 uses 17838 t.
Values from the report and v1.1.16 must not be averaged or silently mixed. Runtime mapping must freeze one executable identity.
raw_matrix_notes: The WAMIT .hst and auxiliary second-order .frc matrices contain small nonsymmetric off-diagonal entries in the source files.
The hydrostatic and auxiliary .frc entries retain the rounded source asymmetry. The added-mass matrix is a rounded dimensional transcription whose reciprocal terms may collapse to one value.
A runtime model must record any further symmetrization or coordinate transformation instead of changing the evidence silently.

active_ballast_boundary.public_location_description: primarily distributed through the three submerged pontoons
active_ballast_boundary.required_runtime_form: complete reference properties plus signed controllable tank increments

prohibited_interpretations: Do not call platform mass a dry mass; it already includes fixed and fluid reference ballast.
Do not infer active tank centers from the 51.75 m outer-column radius.
Do not infer active tank capacity from the 11300 t reference ballast inventory.
Do not back-solve a total GM from the WAMIT hull-only roll or pitch stiffness.
Do not use a period-fit inertia multiplier as a direct public parameter.
Do not use this evidence manifest as a controller plant until a separate runtime assembly recipe is confirmed and reference-frame and open-loop acceptance tests pass.
Do not add the platform-only and whole-system rigid-body representations together.
Do not combine any rigid-body representation with added mass merely because the resulting matrix is positive definite.
